<h2 id="Gonzales-2014-%E2%80%94-IC50-dose-response-(Hill-equation)">Gonzales 2014 — IC50 dose-response (Hill equation)<a class="anchor-link" href="#Gonzales-2014-%E2%80%94-IC50-dose-response-(Hill-equation)">¶</a></h2><p><strong>4-parameter logistic (inhibition framing):</strong></p>
<p>$$\mathrm{Response} = \mathrm{Bottom} + \frac{\mathrm{Top}-\mathrm{Bottom}}{1 + (\mathrm{IC50}/[\mathrm{Drug}])^n}$$</p>
<p>Published IC50 values for oclacitinib <strong>enzyme-level</strong> JAK inhibition (Table 1, clinic therapeutics review / vet pharmacology literature) drive the sweep below. The wetSpring frozen domain JSON instead carries the <strong>cytokine pathway</strong> Table-1 panel used by <code>science.gonzales.dose_response</code>—we reconcile both in the Rust parity cell.</p>
<p><strong>Selectivity (this notebook panel):</strong> JAK3/JAK1 = $310\times$, TYK2/JAK1 = $220\times$.</p>

<h2 id="Fleck-&amp;-Gonzales-2021-%E2%80%94-PK-exponential-decay">Fleck &amp; Gonzales 2021 — PK exponential decay<a class="anchor-link" href="#Fleck-&amp;-Gonzales-2021-%E2%80%94-PK-exponential-decay">¶</a></h2><p><strong>One-compartment IV bolus</strong></p>
<p>$$C(t) = \frac{Dose}{V_d} e^{-k_{el} t},\quad k_{el} = \frac{\ln 2}{t_{1/2}}$$</p>

bounds with clinically validated thresholds for your manuscript.</p>
